record.paper_title: Some Open Questions on Anti-de Sitter Geometry
record.original_question: Let M be a globally hyperbolic anti-de Sitter 3-manifold with massive particles, meaning cone singularities of angle less than π along timelike lines. Is there a unique maximal spacelike surface in M that is orthogonal to the particle worldlines?

evidence.quote: Question 6.2. Is there a unique maximal space-like surface in M orthogonal to the particles?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a globally hyperbolic maximal anti-de Sitter 3-manifold with particles. By this we mean a 3-dimensional Lorentz manifold of constant sectional curvature $-1$ which is globally hyperbolic (it admits a closed spacelike Cauchy surface that meets every inextendible timelike curve exactly once) and maximal (it cannot be isometrically embedded as a proper open subset of another such manifold), and which carries cone singularities of fixed angles strictly less than $\pi$ along a finite collection of disjoint timelike lines (the "particles"). A spacelike surface $\Sigma\subset M$ disjoint from the singular locus except at transverse intersection points is called maximal if its mean curvature vanishes identically. The surface is said to be orthogonal to the particles if at each point where it meets a singular line, its tangent plane is orthogonal to that line.

Prove or disprove: there exists a unique closed maximal spacelike surface in $M$ which is orthogonal to all the particle worldlines.
artifact.category_tag: Anti-de Sitter geometry with cone singularities
artifact.status_search_result: Toulisse (Annales de l'Institut Fourier 66 (2016), no. 4, 1409–1449; arXiv:1312.2724, 2013/2015) proved the existence and uniqueness of a maximal spacelike surface orthogonal to the particles in any globally hyperbolic maximal anti-de Sitter 3-manifold with particles whose cone angles are less than π, settling the question affirmatively.

status_evidence.title: Maximal surfaces in anti-de Sitter 3-manifolds with particles (Toulisse)
status_evidence.snippet: We prove existence and uniqueness of a maximal surface in any globally hyperbolic convex anti-de Sitter manifold with particles (cone singularities of angle less than π along timelike lines).
status_evidence.claim: Existence and uniqueness of a maximal spacelike surface orthogonal to the particles is established for AdS GHM 3-manifolds with cone angles less than π.

status_evidence.title: Maximal surfaces in anti-de Sitter 3-manifolds with particles — Annales de l'Institut Fourier
status_evidence.snippet: Published version of Toulisse's theorem on existence and uniqueness of maximal surfaces in AdS GHM manifolds with particles.
status_evidence.claim: Peer-reviewed publication confirming the resolution of the uniqueness question.
